verdict.rationale: Mastra is fundamentally code-first: agents, workflows, tools, memory, and streaming are all defined and driven via the TypeScript API, and the CLI (`npx mastra api workflow run ...`) confirms that workflows built in Studio can be triggered identically outside the UI (mastra-docs-31). Mastra Studio (localhost:4111) is described as a UI layer for building/testing/managing these same primitives (mastra-docs-30), implying strong API/UI parity by design, but there is no explicit statement of full parity and a discoverable OpenAPI spec could not be found (mastra-probe-3 returned 404s for all candidate paths). Missing for 10: explicit vendor documentation stating 'everything in Studio is available via API', a published OpenAPI/REST reference, and independent/hands-on confirmation that no UI-only features exist.
